toxicity.Notes: acute toxicity for MTD determination in healthy female KM mice, n = 6 per dose, single i.p. injection, 14 days (SI Table S1: individual survival data); deaths: 3 of 6 at 90 mg/kg (days 8, 11, 11) and 3 of 6 at 120 mg/kg (days 8, 10, 12), none at 20-60 mg/kg; the main text mentions mortality at 60 mg/kg as well, which the table does not show; Fig. 4b: body weight at 90-120 mg/kg falls from about 26.5 to 23-24 g in the first days; histology (H&E, Masson): congestion, oedema, vacuolisation and hepatic fibrosis at 60-120 mg/kg, no abnormalities at 40 mg/kg and below; authors conclude that doses up to 40 mg/kg are safe, entered as MTD; no LD50 calculated by the authors
